answer: An anti-Sybil proof-of-bandwidth layer. Before voting, a node passes a live throughput probe and gets a violet one-time credential bound to that window, so borrowed identities cannot be replayed. Probes meet in an unlinkable nebula mix where a fake-swarm operator cannot map a measured path to a key, erasing the cost edge of hollow identities. Each credential carries a saffron mark: a non-transferable on-chain dye exposing reused credentials for slashing. Bandwidth proves scarce capacity, the nebula hides the mapping, and the saffron dye keeps each attestation singular and traceable.
